Title: Robotics — Further reading

R. Andrew Russell (1990). Robot Tactile Sensing. New York: Prentice Hall. ISBN 978-0-13-781592-0. McGaughey, Ewan (16 October 2019). "Will robots automate your job away? clues.clue: It's how we perceive the world around us, a way of feeling and knowing.
This word is related to the way robots interact with their environment.
The act of perceiving or feeling something.
A process that's changing the face of work, making some tasks obsolete.
This concept is closely tied to the idea of machines performing tasks on their own.
The use of machines or computers to control and operate something.
The things we do to earn a living, but will they still exist in the future?
These are the positions or roles that people occupy in the workforce.
A regular activity performed in exchange for payment.
The state of having a job or being paid to work, but what happens when machines take over?
This term refers to the act of giving someone a job or position.
The act of having a paid job or position.
The money that comes in, but will it be enough in a world of automation?
This is the amount of money received, especially on a regular basis.
Money earned or received, especially on a regular basis.
Different ways of looking at things, like angles on a puzzle.
These are the points of view or opinions on a particular subject.
A particular attitude or point of view.
A system where power is held by the people, but can it survive in a world of automation?
This is a system of government where power is held by the people.
A system of government in which power is vested in the people.
A look back at something, like a book or a movie.
This is an evaluation or assessment of something, like a book or a performance.
An evaluation or assessment of something.
The study of money and trade, but also a way of life.
This term refers to the production, distribution, and consumption of goods and services.
Relating to the economy or the study of economics.
The time that is yet to come, full of possibilities and uncertainties.
This is the period of time that has not yet happened.
The time that is to come.
